name: ATV Projects India Limited
about: ATV Projects India Limited manufactures and trades engineering equipment. The company offers desalters, cryogenic vessels, distillation columns, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, boilers, reactors, bullets, strippers, Horton spheres, autoclaves, chemical plant equipment, towers, sugar plant equipment, tank-lined/unlined, cement plant equipment, mixers, hydro power plant equipment, crystallization, and evaporators; and bagasse fired water tube, fluidized bed combustion, multifuel water and smoke tube, and waste heat recovery boilers. It also constructs tanks for storing chemicals and petroleum products; and manufactures and sells fixed and floating roof tanks. In addition, the company provides thermal power plant equipment, such as boilers drums, chimney, and bunkers, as well as FD fans; project supplies/services; and hydro power plant equipment comprising spiral casing, distributor, turbine housing, DT liner, and MIV valves. Its products are used in sugar, chemical and petrochemical, fertilizer, power, nuclear power, food and dairy, cement, and railway industries. ATV Projects India Limited was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
